name: Valentin Borisovich Aleskovskii
summary: Soviet chemist who proposed the framework hypothesis and co-developed molecular layering.

name: Stanislav Ivanovich Kol'tsov
summary: Soviet chemist and graduate student of Aleskovskii who experimentally established the molecular layering method.

name: Leningrad Technological Institute by Lensovet
summary: Russia's oldest chemical engineering institute, now known as St. Petersburg State Technological Institute.

name: Leningrad State University
summary: Major Russian university where Aleskovskii served as rector and founded a solid state chemistry department.

name: Naval Research Institute
summary: Leningrad institution where Aleskovskii worked as a research fellow after graduating in 1937.

name: Academy of Sciences of the USSR
summary: Premier scientific academy in the Soviet Union.

name: Tapani Suntola
summary: Finnish physicist who independently developed atomic layer epitaxy and patented it in 1974.

name: Virtual Project on the History of ALD
summary: International collaborative initiative launched in 2013 to document the history of ALD/ML.

name: Mary
summary: City in Turkmenistan where Aleskovskii was born.

name: St. Petersburg
summary: Russian city where Aleskovskii conducted most of his research and lived.
